description: Java class UserProfileHandler that extends DefaultHandler to parse XML profile data for ECU configuration in the RomRaider project.

classes.name: UserProfileHandler
classes.description: A SAX parser handler for processing ECU profile XML data, extracting profile parameters, switches, and external items.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes maps for profile parameters, switches, and external items at the start of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of XML elements, extracting attributes and populating corresponding maps.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Constructs and returns a UserProfile object with parsed data.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Creates a UserProfileItem instance based on element attributes.
